orderedEvents.reason: WebGPU device lost: Device was destroyed.

knownLimitations: Tested on Chrome 156.0.8078.76, macOS 27 arm64; no hardware acceleration claim is made.

The available r187 environment exposed the explicit callback-equivalent and adapter-owned GPUDevice.destroy() controls, but no independent external device-loss trigger. No spontaneous or driver-caused loss is inferred from either test-induced path.
The controlled hold delays adapter settlement after native submission; it does not claim the GPU queue remained physically busy for the full hold interval.

knownLimitations: The broad current-head suite has 99 unexpected outcomes across UI visibility, long-running renderer/resource tests, stale r186 revision assertions, and Vite optimized-module loading; these are outside the M7G lifecycle scenarios.
The named Architecture + Foreground missing-heading failure and two r187 baseline assertion failures were reproduced on a clean origin/main snapshot.

The other broad-suite failures were not individually replayed on clean main and remain unclassified baseline/application failures; broad E2E is therefore blocked rather than treated as M7G pass evidence.
